map.title: Airport – fictional drone training map
map.coordinate_note: Fictional placement. lat/lon are generated with a local flat-earth projection around the map centre; change origin_lat/origin_lon and recompute to move the map anywhere. px = pixel position in the image (x right, y down). All objects are listed at their centre point.

units.length_m: size along heading (or E-W extent for polygons)

operational_area.description: Drones leaving this polygon are considered LOST. The boundary exists only in this file; it is not drawn in the image (the landscape continues normally outside it).

grid.note: Column A starts at the west edge, row 1 at the north edge (e.g. cell E4).
